title: The Credit Card Cashback Trap (Exact Math)

beats.say: Your 2% cashback card is making the bank rich while paying you pennies.
beats.visual: Overhead cinematic view of a sleek metallic credit card resting on a dark marble surface, dramatic side lighting.

beats.say: Here's the exact math showing how a tiny $1,500 balance destroys an entire year of rewards.
beats.visual: Close-up silhouette of hands holding a dark smartphone, subtle blue glow, soft bokeh background.

beats.say: Imagine you spend $2,000 every single month on your card to max out cash rewards.
beats.visual: A sleek leather wallet lying open next to receipts on a dark wooden desk, dim mood lighting.

beats.say: At 2% cashback, you earn $40 every month in reward points.
beats.visual: A single shiny silver coin sitting under a tight spotlight on a dark textured background.

beats.say: Over 12 full months, that adds up to $480 of seemingly free cash.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of neatly stacked crisp dollar bills on a polished table, dramatic contrast.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person sitting in a dimly lit room facing a tall foggy window, evening atmosphere.

beats.say: If you carry a minor $1,500 balance past your monthly due date, interest kicks in.
beats.visual: Moody shot of a brass hourglass with sand running down on a metallic counter, dim light.

beats.say: At a standard 22% APR, that $1,500 balance charges you $330 in annual interest.
beats.visual: Close-up of a pen leaning against an open leather ledger book in a shadowy office.

beats.say: That single small balance instantly steals nearly 70% of your total yearly earnings.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive modern bank building made of glass and steel under stormy clouds.

beats.say: Carry just $2,200 at 22% APR, and interest hits $484, completely wiping out every reward dollar.
beats.visual: A single lit candle slowly extinguishing on a cold stone background, dark cinematic tone.

beats.say: Cashback isn't a free bonus; it's bait engineered to keep you in high-interest debt.
beats.visual: Close-up shot of heavy vintage keys resting on a dark oak desk, moody side lighting.

beats.say: If you carry any balance at all, you aren't beating the system, you're funding it.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing at the end of a long dark hallway lit by a single distant doorway.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, so cashback cards never trick you.
beats.visual: Atmospheric shot of a quiet leather-bound notebook sitting closed under warm desk light.

caption:
Think 2% cashback is free money? Here is the hidden math banks don't highlight.

#money #personalfinance #creditcards #personalfinancetips #financialliteracy
description: A 2% cashback reward sounds great on paper, but carrying even a small balance wipes out your earnings instantly. Learn how credit card interest negates cashback rewards with exact numbers.
first_comment: Do you pay off your credit card balance in full every single month?

facts.claim: 2% cashback on $2,000 monthly spend equals $480 per year
$1,500 balance at 22% APR equals $330 annual interest
$2,200 balance at 22% APR equals $484 annual interest
